esprit.title: A cabinet of curiosities made for rummaging
esprit.text: Here, you take your time. The rails change with every delivery, the jewellery glints in its cases and every visit holds a surprise. The welcome is simple and warm: advice if you want it, room to dream if you don't.

bijoux.title: The little treasures that change everything
bijoux.text: An old ring, a forgotten brooch, a bag that has already travelled: it's often the details that make the outfit. They're chosen with care and never stay long.

infos.title: Visit the shop
infos.accessText: In the Henriville area, south of the city centre, about fifteen minutes' walk from Amiens station. Street parking nearby.
infos.mapTitle: Map to Fripes Merveilles, 151 rue Gaulthier de Rumilly, Amiens

items.a: The shop is open Wednesday to Saturday, 10am to 7pm. Exceptional closures are announced at the top of the site.
There are new arrivals every week. The pieces of the moment are on the New in page, and the banner at the top tells you when a delivery has just come in.

items.q: How do I reserve a piece?
items.a: Tap “Reserve on WhatsApp” under the piece, or fill in the reservation form: a ready-made message goes to the shop. The piece is kept aside for a few days, so you have time to come and collect it.

items.q: Which payment methods do you accept?
items.a: Cash and card. If in doubt, a quick WhatsApp message will tell you.

items.q: Do you take clothes on consignment?
items.a: It's being considered. Tell us about your clothes through the Consignment form, with photos: the shop replies directly on WhatsApp.
The shop is at 151 rue Gaulthier de Rumilly, in the Henriville area. Park in the nearby streets; Amiens station is about fifteen minutes away on foot.

friperie.intro: Fripes Merveilles is the Henriville neighbourhood thrift shop: second-hand clothing for women and men, vintage, jewellery and accessories, with new pieces every week.

list.text: Dresses, skirts, knitwear, blouses, jeans, jackets and coats, from XS to larger sizes depending on deliveries.

list.title: Men's clothing
list.text: Shirts, jumpers, sweatshirts, denim and jackets, from basics to pieces with character.

why.title: Fabrics that last

bijoux.intro: Jewellery is one of Fripes Merveilles' prides: second-hand rings, earrings, necklaces and brooches, chosen for their charm. They go fast: drop by often, or reserve on WhatsApp.

list.title: Rings

list.title: Earrings
list.text: Hoops, drops and vintage clip-ons, whatever your mood.

list.title: Necklaces
list.text: Chains, beads and pendants to lift a simple outfit.

list.title: Brooches and watches
list.text: Little objects from the past, to wear or to give.

why.title: A gift with a story

why.title: A gentle price
